questions.question: John the Baptist told his disciples that he himself was the Christ. True or false?
When John the Baptist heard that everyone was going to Jesus, what did he say about Jesus and himself?

answers.text: He must increase and I must decrease
We must grow side by side
I must lead and He must follow
